stories.title: Mold archive centre to replace Flintshire Record Office in Hawarden approved
stories.summary: Plans for an archive centre in Mold that will replace the Flintshire Record Office in Hawarden have been approved by councillors. stories.title: Flintshire schools forecast to be £8.2m in the red next year, and the council says it could get worse
stories.summary: Flintshire’s schools are forecast to be £8.2 million in the red by next March, as the council’s audited accounts confirm schools ended last year in deficit. stories.title: CMA proposes opening up iPhone contactless payments to rival apps
stories.summary: Apple could be required to open up the iPhone’s contactless technology to rival payment apps, digital IDs and travel passes under proposals from the UK’s competition watchdog. stories.title: Holywell strikes Gold at Wales in Bloom for the first time
stories.summary: Holywell has been awarded Gold in the town category of the Wales in Bloom Awards 2026, which Holywell Town Council says is the first time the town has achieved it. stories.title: Flintshire residents warned over council tax credit scam email
